sloka: मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां ये च पश्यन्ति केचन ।पाविताः स्वर्गभूताश्च पूज्यास्ते सर्वदैवतैः ।। ७.८२.१० ॥
transliteration: muhūrtamapi rāma tvāṁ ye ca paśyanti kecana ।pāvitāḥ svargabhūtāśca pūjyāste sarvadaivataiḥ ।। 7.82.10 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, even those who merely see you for a moment become purified and attain heaven, and they are then worshipable by all deities.
